name: 免打孔壁挂多层收纳架款

shots.intent: 搜索页一眼点击：整架与免钉背板、挂钩排完整可读，主体干净无干扰。
主图一秒法则：用一面米色信息板把核心主张「免打孔壁挂 + 多层自由组合」讲清。
shots.textZone: top-left headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D at 40pt, plus two thin-outline tag chips reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt beneath it

shots.intent: 放大真实痛点：打孔掉砖、墙面留洞、湿毛巾堆在台面上无处安放。
shots.textZone: single short label 「{selling_point_2}」 in #2D2D2D at 30pt across the top band, shared by both halves

shots.intent: 自我代入：洗漱台侧墙挂架后毛巾与瓶罐各归位，湿区收纳一眼可信。
扩场景：同一挂架在厨房墙面承托盘碟与托盘，证明浴室厨房两用。
以材质与工艺细节支撑耐用主张：端面壁厚、阳极或木质表面纹理真实可读。
shots.textZone: right-side thin-line label 「{callout_4}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt with a 1px leader line to the cut face

shots.intent: 解释机制：免钉背板、贴合面与挂钩排的结构关系看清，消除掉落疑虑。
shots.textZone: two thin-outline labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_5}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt along the top edge with 1px leader lines

shots.intent: 消除尺寸疑虑：正视立面加尺寸引线并以常见物件作尺度参照。
shots.textZone: top dimension leader line reading 「{callout_2}」 and bottom-left label 「{callout_6}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt, thin 1px lines with arrow terminations

shots.intent: 证明差异：同框同光对照螺丝固定与免钉贴合两种方式对墙面的影响。
shots.textZone: two small top labels 「{callout_5}」 and 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt, one per panel

shots.intent: 让买家自选：同一机位排开不同层数与饰面组合，看清可选规格。
shots.textZone: one caption under each unit reading 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_6}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt

shots.intent: 去风险：以真实载荷与贴合墙面的接触阴影证明挂架的稳固感，不引用任何证书。
shots.textZone: bottom-left short label 「{callout_4}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt, no badge shapes

shots.intent: 收口转化：用一句主张加一枚行动按钮把多层组合的选购逻辑收住。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D at 36pt top-left, CTA button with rendered copy 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D on an #C89B62 pill with 8px rounded corners at the lower third

style.backgroundSystem: one surface family per shot: seamless #FFFFFF studio field, matte greige info panel #F2EAE3, or matte porcelain wall tile #E7E4E0; never photographic scenery behind infographic panels
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons in #2D2D2D, rounded terminals, no fills, no emoji, no 3D badges
style.lightingSystem: soft front-left key with bounce fill, gentle directional rim along the mounting wall, soft contact shadows only, 4800-5500K, no hard drop shadows
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean #FFFFFF, matte greige info panel #F2EAE3, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D and one oak accent #C89B62 (or {accent_color} when a brand hue is supplied); neutral 4800-5500K studio lighting with a soft front-left key, bounce fill and soft contact shadows only; one modern geometric sans-serif family for every rendered Chinese and Latin label, headline 28-48pt and label 10-14pt, Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; background system of seamless #FFFFFF, matte greige panel #F2EAE3 and matte porcelain wall tile #E7E4E0, one surface family per shot; layout system of generous top-left text blocks, thin 1px rule lines, 8px rounded card corners, numbered feature rows and dimension leader lines; icon system of single-weight thin line icons in #2D2D2D with no fills; product presentation stays wall-mounted with true verticals, stable scale and identical placement logic across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no source brand wordmark or store badges
style.presentationRules: product always wall-mounted or board-flat with true verticals and correct perspective, identical scale logic across the set, hook row and mounting plate legible in at least three shots, product never floating without a contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: matte porcelain tile #E7E4E0 wall planes, matte greige counter and shelf boards, brushed metal and matte timber edge finishes with visible grain and anodised texture
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all rendered Chinese and Latin text; headline 28-48pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt; Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」 and supplied as placeholders
